summary.text: Clinton Collamore Sr. is an independent candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Rebecca Stephens; there is no incumbent in the race.
A former Democratic member of the House for the district, he served from December 6, 2022, to February 15, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Clinton Collamore Sr., also known as Clint, lives in Waldoboro, Maine.
He earned a B.S. from the University of Maine at Augusta in 2009, and his career experience includes working as a lobsterman.
Collamore ran as a Democrat in the 2022 general election for Maine House District 45 and defeated Republican Lynn Madison, 53.2 percent to 46.8 percent.
He assumed office on December 6, 2022, and left office on February 15, 2023.
In 2026 he is on the November ballot as an independent.
